name: Earthborn

abilities.name: Earth Form
Earthen Body
abilities.effect:
Gain the following:
* Replace the _Natural_ _Material_ with _Earth_ on all effects.
* You gain Resistance_ to _Fire_, _Cold_, and _Lightning_.

desc: You're a spirit of earth, as indomitable and unbreakable as a mountain.

name: Waterborn

abilities.name: Water Form
Aquatic Body
abilities.effect:
Gain the following:
* Replace the _Natural_ _Material_ with _Water_ on all effects.
* You have _Resistance_ to _Fire_, _Crush_, and _Natural_.
* You have_Weakness_ to _Cold_ and _Lightning_.
* You cannot gain _Soaked_; when you would gain 5 _Stamina_ or _Guard_ in any combination.

desc: You're a spirit of earth, as indomitable and unbreakable as a mountain.

name: Flameborn
desc: You are a spirit formed from flame, flickering and always hungry.

abilities.name: Flame Form
Flame Body
abilities.effect:
Gain the following:
* Remove the _Natural_ _Material_ on all effects; add _Fire_ to the Damage Type.
* You have _Resistance_ to _Natural_, _Fire_, and _Cold_.
* You have _Weakness_ to _Water_.
* You cannot gain _Alight_; when you would (after applying _Resistance_), gain an equivalent amount of _Stamina_ or _Guard_ in any combination.
* You cannot gain _Soaked_; when you would, instead take 5 Damage and become _Impaired_ and _Exposed_.

abilities.name: Roaring Fire
abilities.effect: Add _Alight_ 3.

abilities.name: Burning Aura
abilities.effect: Whenever you are targeted by a _Melee_ Attack, the Attacker takes 2 _Fire_ _Damage_.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.effect: For the remainder of the _Turn_, _Ignite_ any _Terrain_ you _Engage_.

name: Metalborn

abilities.name: Metal Form
Metallic Body
abilities.effect:
Your metallic form grants you the following benefits:
* Replace the _Natural_ _Material_ with _Metal_ on all effects.
* You have _Resistance_ to _Stab_, _Crush_, and _Slash_.
* You have a _Weakness_ to _Lightning_.

desc: You're a spirit of metal, cold and unyielding.

name: Windborn

abilities.name: Wind Form
Wind Body
abilities.effect:
Your wind form grants you the following benefits:
* Replace the _Natural_ _Material_ with _Wind_ on all effects.
* You never suffer ill effects from _Falling_.
* You have _Resistance_ to _Crush_, _Natural_, and _Lightning_.

desc: You're a spirit of wind, ethereal and free.

name: Woodborn

abilities.name: Wooden Form
Wooden Body
abilities.effect:
Your wooden form grants you the following effects:
* Replace the _Natural_ _Material_ with _Wood_ on all effects.
* You have _Resistance_ to _Crush_ and _Stab_.
* You have a _Weakness_ to _Fire_.

desc: You're a spirit of wood, adaptable and ever-growing.

name: Lightly Armored
prereqs: Metal, Earth, Wood, or Ice Spirit, and no other [Armored] Traits.

abilities.name: Light Armor
abilities.effect: This spirit gains _Light Natural Armor_.

desc: You have scales, a thin shell, or some other natural defense mechanism that provides some limited protection.

name: Moderately Armored
prereqs: Metal, Earth, Wood, or Ice Spirit, and no other [Armored] Traits.

abilities.name: Medium Armor
abilities.effect: This spirit gains the _Medium Natural Armor_.

desc: You have a shell, thick elemental plating, or some other natural defense mechanism that provides some protection.

name: Multiple Heads

abilities.name: Split Perception
Sleep Shifting
abilities.effect: You can strategically sleep in such a way that one head is always awake and watchful. While making a _Camp Roll_, you may spend [ ] to remove the _Crash_ _Affliction_. Additionally, you may remove this _Danger_ even if you would normally be unable to remove it.

abilities.name: Two Minds
abilities.effect: Gain +3 _Guard_. Once per _Round_, you may _Negate_ an _Emotional Status_, _Blinded_, _Impaired_, _Exposed_, or _Vulnerable_ at half cost.

desc: You have multiple heads, allowing you to look in multiple directions at the same time and bicker with yourself in a cute fashion.

name: Sure-Footed

abilities.name: Perfect Footing
Confident Mobility
abilities.effect: Once per _Round_ you may ignore any increased _Speed_ cost due to _Terrain_ at no cost. You may refresh this ability for 1 _Momentum_ at any point.

desc: You have an impeccable sense of balance, allowing you to move safely and confidently through anything.

name: Harrier

abilities.name: Harrying Combatant
abilities.effect: Your are nimble and fast, with a fighting style that allows you to slip in and out of foes' reach in a flash as you distract and confuse. Once per Skill Challenge, when your ability to distract and harry foes would be of assistance gain an automatic _Advantage_ stake when your horns would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Distract
abilities.desc: You charge a foe, obstructing their vision and distracting them, drawing their attention for a moment before you slip away.
abilities.effect: Attack a Target within Range. The Target may not Attack you this _Turn_.

analysis_notes.analysis_notes: Speed cost, minus the (partial) free Disengage

enhances.name: Draw Ire
enhances.effect: On a _Graze_+, add _Impaired_ at the same _Negate_ _Cost_ as you force your opponent to momentarily think about attacking you.

abilities.name: Harrying Assault
abilities.effect:
You may either:
* If the original Attack was not <u>Distract</u>, use <u>Distract</u> on the Target of the original Attack at no Cost. You automatically _Hit_.
* Use <u>Distract</u> on the closest enemy you haven't attacked this _Turn_ at no Cost.  You automatically _Hit_. You may leave your _Engagement_ to do this and must pay all _Speed_ costs as normal, but Attacks against you this _Turn_ have _Disadvantage_.

desc: You excel at distracting and confusing foes, darting in and out of their reach without a worry.

name: Flowering
prereqs: Wood Spirit and at least _Novice Bloomcraft_.

abilities.name: Natural Bloom
Fruiting
abilities.effect: Some of your flowers bloom into small fruit and other useful plants. Gain _Supplies_, and 1 _Stress_.

abilities.name: Sprouting
abilities.effect: While in _Fertile_ Terrain, gain +1 _Stamina_ and +2 _Guard_ at _Respite_. You are an infinite source of _Small_ _Wood_ objects that can be removed without harming you.

stances.name: Blooming Spirit
stances.desc: You send down roots, spreading bloom across your arena.
stances.prereqs: You may only enter this _Stance_ if it is possible for plantlife to grow in your _Arena_.

abilities.name: Ingrained
abilities.effect: You may not spend _Speed_, but your _Arena_ is _Fertile_ this _Round_.

abilities.name: Rapid Growth
abilities.effect: At _Respite_, you may choose to make your _Arena_ _Overgrown_. End this effect when you leave this _Stance_.

stances.adjust_notes: Free Fertile and free Overgrown, but can't move

desc: You're covered in small, flowering growths that can be encouraged to grow at a moment's notice.

name: Metallic Threads

abilities.name: Threads
Subtle Web
abilities.effect: You may lay down a web of fine metal wires to help secure the camp. When your companion takes the _Work_ _Camp Action_ or by taking a _Fatigue_ you may add _Webbed_ to your camp, which makes it more difficult to approach your camp and allows you to start with 6 Web Traps (see the Web Trap Ability from this Trait) if combat occurs.

abilities.name: Wire Whip
abilities.effect: Attack a Target within _Range_. You may deal no Damage to reduce the cost of <u>Entangle</u> by 1, but must choose prior to making the Attack.

enhances.name: Entangle
enhances.effect: Add _Entangled_ [4] on a _Graze_+, or _Entangled_ [5] on a _Crit_.

abilities.name: Web Trap
abilities.effect: Create a Metallic Web in _Range_ 0, which is a _Medium_ _Metal_ object. When a creature becomes _Engaged_ with Metallic Web they must _Negate_ [4] or gain _Entangled_; this is also inflicted if the Metallic Web is used for an Attack. You are immune to all Metallic Webs you create.

desc: You can emit thin metallic threads, similar to a spider.

name: Locust Biology

abilities.name: Locust Biology
abilities.effect: Gain _Resistance_ to _Poison_.

desc: Locusts are near-impervious to poison due to their heavy reliance on it.

name: Strong Jaws

abilities.name: Crushing Jaws
abilities.effect: Your powerful jaws are mighty weapons, allowing you to grasp onto a foe and control them. Once per Skill Challenge gain an automatic _Vexation_ stake when your jaws would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Jaws
abilities.desc: A natural weapon suitable for mighty jaws and other things that rip and tear.
abilities.effect: You may treat your Size as one higher for the Grab. If the _Target_ is already _Grabbed_, make your Attack with _Advantage_. After inflicting _Grabbed_, whenever a target attempts to escape they take 2 Damage.

enhances.name: Ripping Crush
enhances.effect: You may only choose this _Enhancement_ if you have the Target _Grabbed_. Add _Bleeding_ [5] to the Attack.

desc: You have powerful jaws that foes have a hard time escaping from.

name: Piercing Horns

abilities.name: Horned Wrath
abilities.effect: Your powerful horns or antlers are mighty weapons, especially when you have room to maneuver. Once per Skill Challenge, if you have room to maneuver, gain an automatic _Efficacy_ stake when your horns would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Horns
abilities.desc: A natural weapon suitable for sharp horns, antlers, and similar growths.
abilities.effect: If you became _Engaged_ with the Target this _Turn_, deal +1 Damage, even on a _Miss_.

enhances.name: Driving Ram
enhances.effect: Add _Push_ [2/4]. If you _Push_, you may move with the Target, reducing any _Speed_ costs by 1 and adding [_Safe_].

enhances.name: Head Down
enhances.effect: Deal +_1/2/2/3_ Damage. If you Miss, lose 4 _Guard_ and gain _Exposed_. If you _Graze_, lose 2 _Guard_.

desc: You have sharp horns that can pierce deep into foes.

name: Bright Fangs

abilities.name: Fanged Assault
abilities.effect: Your fangs make you incredibly deadly in single combat, especially when you have the element of surprise. Once per Skill Challenge, if you are in single combat, gain an automatic _Efficacy_ stake when your horns would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Fangs
abilities.desc: A natural weapon suitable for fangs and other quick, piercing appendages.
abilities.effect: Attack a Target within Range. If you have _Advantage_, add [_Piercing_].

enhances.name: Flash
enhances.effect: If the Target has not taken their _Turn_ yet this _Round_, gain _Advantage_.

enhances.name: Double Snap
enhances.effect: Add [_Glancing_] to the Attack. After completing the attack, repeat it against the same Target, adding [_Glancing_, _Follow-Up_].

analysis_notes.notes: 4+6 and 6+4 is two more potential Gambits for 5.55%, x2 for 2 Momentum

desc: You have sharp, flashing fangs that can quickly disable a foe.

name: Sharp Claws

abilities.name: Rending Claws
abilities.effect: Your claws are incredibly deadly and are an incredibly lethal opening assault. On the very first round of a _Skill Challenge_, gain an automatic _Efficacy_ stake when your claws would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.desc: A natural weapon suitable for claws, talons, and all similar appendages.
abilities.effect: Make two Attacks that you may move between. For every two times you _Hit_+ a Target in a _Turn_, inflict _Bleeding_ [4].

enhances.name: Furious Assault
enhances.effect: Attack the same Target again at a -1 _Penalty_. You may repeat this _Enhancement_, but take an additional -1 _Penalty_ each time.

enhances.name: Rend
enhances.effect: You must _Hit_+ before you can use this. Add [_Piercing_] and a +1 to the _Attack Roll_ to all subsequent <u>Claw</u> Attacks against the Target this _Turn_.

analysis_notes.notes: Attacking twice is good; fudge is for Gambit value inherent to an attack.

desc: You have sharp claws useful for attacking foes.

name: Heavy Stinger

abilities.name: Powerful Sting
abilities.effect: You have a heavy stinger that you can use to attack with from a distance. Once per skill challenge _Skill Challenge_, gain an automatic _Vexation_ stake when your stinger would aid in battle.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.desc: A natural weapon suitable for powerful stingers and similar piercing attacks.
abilities.effect: Attack a Target within Range.

enhances.name: Pin
enhances.effect: Add _Hobbled_ to the Attack. While the enemy is _Hobbled_, you both may not leave your current _Arena_ and you may not use this Attack against any other Targets.

enhances.name: Pierce
enhances.effect: Add [_Piercing_] and deal +_1/2/4/5_ Damage with the triggering Attack.

desc: You have a powerful piercing weapon like a scorpion's stinger that can punch through most defenses.

name: Climber

abilities.name: Natural Climber
Skilled Climber
abilities.effect: While _Climbing_ you are always treated as if you had _Free Hands_ and do not have _Disadvantage_ on rolls due to _Climbing_. Additionally, you may spend _Momentum_ as _Speed_ when paying the increased Cost due to _Climbing_.

desc: You're a natural climber, allowing you to easily scale even the most sheer of surfaces.

name: Keen Nose

abilities.name: Scent
Boon of Scent
abilities.effect: When traveling, your companion may always play [ ] to track a target or follow a trail.

abilities.name: Scent Trail
abilities.effect: When _Menace_ or _Discovery_ is drawn, you may attempt to glean more info. If your sense of smell would aid in detecting this, immediately learn additional information, such as the consequences of failure. You may spend [ ] to reveal this card. If your sense of smell is not relevant, do not expend a use.

desc: You have a keen sense of smell, allowing you track others with ease.

name: Predator

abilities.name: Natural Predator
Skilled Hunter
abilities.effect: While you are manifested while traveling, your companion may spend a single [ ] as if it was _Efficacy_ to do the _Hunt_ _Travel Action_. This does not require that they choose _Hunt_ if they play _Efficacy_ through another means. Additionally, when your companion takes the _Hunt_ _Travel Action_ during the _Camp Phase_, you may assist them and grant them an additional die.

abilities.name: Scent of Blood
abilities.effect: You always know the creature within Range 1 with the least current Stamina.

abilities.name: Finisher
abilities.effect: When attacking creatures with less than or equal to half their _Stamina_ or _Health Bar_, gain a +1 to the _Attack Roll_. Additionally, the first Attack each _Round_ against such a creature gains [_Discount_ 1].

stances.name: Hunting Spirit
stances.desc: You choose prey, then viciously strike them.

abilities.name: Mark Prey
abilities.effect: At _Respite_, choose a hostile creature and inflict _Studied_. This _Round_, you may use any number of Attacks so long as they are targeting that creature, and all Attacks automatically add _Stun_ equal to their Cost. Gain 2 _Momentum_ if you defeat that creature. All Attacks against other creature have _Disadvantage_.

desc: You're a natural killer, and excel at hunting and eliminating other creatures.

name: Mountable

abilities.name: Mount
Riding Spirit
abilities.effect: While manifested while traveling, you may choose to carry one of your allies. When doing this, they ignore a single penalty die and you make take a single _Fatigue_ stake for them. Additionally, you may gain _Stress_ to allow them to spend a single [ ] as _Phase_.

abilities.name: Trot
abilities.effect: Gain +1 _Speed_.

abilities.name: Combat Mount
abilities.effect: You may ignore any penalties due to size associated with a single smaller creature _Grabbing_ you. At any point, as a _Reaction_, a smaller ally that is _Engaged_ with you may spend 1 _Speed_ or you may spend 1 _Momentum_ to allow them to immediately _Grab_ you. While grabbed by an ally they may spend your _Speed_ and use your _Mobility_ _Maneuvers_ on their _Turn_, but may not use it to pay for their own abilities.

stances.name: Noble Steed
stances.desc: You focus on transporting an ally, putting your powerful speed to use.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may spend _Speed_ to become _Engaged_ with an ally. They may then _Grab_ you at no _Cost_.

abilities.name: Dedicated Mount
abilities.effect: This _Round_ you may only make _Light_ _Attacks_. You and your rider have _Advantage_ on all _Defense Rolls_ on either of your Turns. Your rider reduces the cost to _Negate_ all _Forced Movement_ effects by 2.

desc: You're a natural killer, and excel at hunting and eliminating other creatures.

name: Man's Best Friend

abilities.name: Constant Companion
Service Animal
abilities.effect: During the _Camp Phase_, choose another character or spirit. They roll a die; on a 5+, they clear a _Stress_. If you fail this roll, you may gain _Stress_ to allow the target to instead succeed.

abilities.name: Friendly Encouragement
abilities.effect:
You call encouragement to the target. Choose one:
* They may gain 3 _Guard_.
* They gain 1 _Momentum_.
* They may _Recover_ once.

enhances.name: Focused Encouragement
enhances.effect: Instead, choose two. You must choose different effects.

desc: You're a naturally friendly creature, and are a closer companion than most spirits.

name: Cute

abilities.name: Cuteness
Big Eyes
abilities.effect: Once per _Leg_, when you are the target of the _Pamper_ _Camp Action_, you may clear a _Stress_ for any present party member.

abilities.name: Avenge the Mascot
abilities.effect: If you are _Defeated_, the next Attack against the creature that _Defeated_ you by an ally may use an additional _Gambit_.

desc: You're an adorable creature, and all those that see you find you irresistible.

name: Skulker
desc: You are a shadow, making no sound with your steps and betraying nothing.

abilities.name: Stealthy
Watchful Shadow
abilities.effect: While traveling, you may stick close to the party, scouting in the shadows. If you do this, the first time you reveal a card from the _Menace Deck_ (by removing the _Menace_ _Danger_) you may choose to exclude _Mishaps_ put there due to party members.

abilities.name: Low-Profile
abilities.effect: While you have _Cover_, you cannot be attacked by Attacks originating from outside your _Arena_. You lose this benefit until the next _Round_ if you Attack or force a creature to _Negate_.

abilities.name: Sneak
abilities.effect: For the rest of this _Turn_ enemies may not _Engage_ you, you do not provoke _Reactions_ and, after completing your _Speed_, you have _Soft Cover_ for the remainder of the round. Lose this benefit if you Attack, force a creature to _Negate_, or become _Engaged_.

name: Extended Reach
desc: You have and extended reach, whether from a serpentine body, long limbs, or some other effect.

abilities.name: Long
Reacher
abilities.effect: You may use all _Melee_ abilities as if they were Range 0 (_Reach_).

abilities.name: Extended Reach
abilities.effect: Use a Single-Target _Reach_ Attack [_Discount_ 1] against the triggering creature.

name: Sprinter
desc: When given an open field few can match your speed and acceleration.

abilities.name: Phasey
Improved Mobility
abilities.effect: Gain +1 _Speed_.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.triger: None. You may use this Reaction at any time, but only once per Round.
abilities.effect: Immediately gain 2 _Speed_ and 1 Fatigue.

name: Beast of Burden
desc: You are an enduring, resilient spirit, and can maintain a physical form longer than most.

abilities.name: Enduring
Unending Endurance
abilities.effect: When you would gain _Fatigue_, you may instead place it on this power. It may be recovered using _Efficacy_ as normal.

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.effect: Gain +2 _Stamina_ and +2 _Guard_. At _Respite_, gain 3 _Guard_.

name: Shepherding Instinct
desc: You have a natural instinct to shepherd and protect those close to you.

abilities.name: Protective Instinct
Watchful Shepherd
abilities.effect: Whenever an ally would suffer an effect they could avoid by being moved you may rescue them, taking the effect in their place.

abilities.name: Shepherd
abilities.effect: An ally in the _Engagement_ may immediately leave it, spending no _Speed_ and creating no _Opening_.

stances.name: Shepherding Spirit
stances.desc: You focus on transporting an ally, putting your powerful speed to use.

abilities.name: Protective
abilities.effect: Increase the _Block_ of all _Engaged_ allies by 2. When you become _Engaged_ with an ally, they gain 2 _Guard_.

abilities.name: Corral
abilities.effect: You may immediately move as if it were your _Turn_, spending _Speed_ as normal and using any _Mobility_ _Maneuvers_ that you wish. Move to _Engage_ the triggering ally. You may then use _Shepherd_ on them.

stances.adjust_notes: Might be low honestly, but defensive stuff should get some juice

name: Swift
desc: You're uncommonly fast and quick on your feet, able to change direction near-instantly and rapidly cover distances.

abilities.name: Swiftness
Dart
abilities.effect: Whenever there's a question of where you are in a situation you may choose, so long as you have the appropriate speed (swimming, climbing, etc.) to accomplish it.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.effect: Gain +1 _Speed_.

abilities.name: Scamper
abilities.trigger: The Player portion of a _Phase_ begins.
abilities.effect: You may move as if it was your _Turn_, spending all resources as normal.

abilities.name: Tiny Size
Diminutive Agility
abilities.effect: Your Spirit becomes Size 1/2 and decreases their _Phase_ by 1 and gains +1 _Speed_. If they are already _Phase_ 1, instead gain an additional +1 _Speed_. Additionally, whenever you would be _Manifested_ adjacent to your companion, you may instead _Manifest_ in any adjacent _Arena_ so long as it has an appropriate _Source_ or at least 1 _Load_ of the appropriate _Element_.

abilities.name: Small Size
Small Profile
abilities.effect: Your Spirit becomes Size 1 and gains +2 _Stamina_ and +1 _Guard_. Additionally, whenever you would be _Manifested_ adjacent to your companion, you may instead _Manifest_ anywhere in the same _Arena_ so long as it has an appropriate _Source_ or at least 2 _Load_ of the appropriate _Element_.

abilities.name: Medium Size
Medium Profile
abilities.effect: Your Spirit becomes Size 2 and gains +3 _Stamina_ and +5 _Guard_.

abilities.name: Large Size
Large Profile
abilities.effect: Your Spirit becomes Size 3 and gains +6 _Stamina_ and +10 _Guard_. Additionally, its _Phase_ and _Manifest Range_ are increased by 1.
